description_en: Send text messages. Before you send a message, you must register a signature and a template
description_zh: 发送短信，使用前须注册签名和模板
kebab_example: aliyun paiplugin send-message --group-id 10ed87f5-3ca8-4a43-9d83-b30519be7241 --out-ids 1234567890 --phone-numbers 1234567890 --schedule-id 08d19262-bd76-48fd-80e8-6a225ac388c1 --sign-name 'PAI通知' --signature-id 5480e3e7-f578-42d2-8ce8-217dec75f2e6 --sms-up-extend-codes 1234567890 --template-code SMS_123456 --template-id b1fe24e2-6a1b-42c6-901e-bfb2e898b5f3 --template-params name_:_张三_,_number_:_15038000076 --payment-type PayAsYouGo --region cn-hangzhou
name: SendMessage

parameters.description_en: The group ID. Use it to associate groups.

parameters.description_en: Mobile phone number. Each mobile phone number corresponds to a template variable, an upstream extension code, and an external extension field. The maximum number of mobile phone numbers is 1000. Example: \["1234567890"].
parameters.description_zh: 手机号，每个手机号对应一个模板变量、上行拓展码和外部拓展字段，号码个数最大为1000，示例：["1234567890"]。
